summary: Frontend + backend E2E of B2G Βήμα Α: auto-send after issue, hourly cron polling, list filter chips + badge, notifications. All 7 required flows PASS. (1) Settings→Δημόσιο(B2G): b2g-autosend-switch toggled ON, saved, and persists after reload (b2g-enabled-switch stayed ON). (2) Happy auto-send: customer 4ffd4deb-…-a833c8 project ref refilled to '1|ΑΔΑ-TEST'; new invoice TP-0006 (ced7b3c9-…) issued without extra clicks; B2G card immediately shows 'Σε αναμονή παρόχου' with providerId SIM-1789197883087 (simulation:pending), no manual send-btn click needed. (3) Missing-field path: customer project ref cleared, new invoice TP-0007 (e3f87521-…) issued successfully (number assigned), B2G stays 'Δεν έχει σταλεί', bell notification appears titled 'Το ΤΠ-0007 δεν στάλθηκε στο Δημόσιο' body 'Λείπουν υποχρεωτικά στοιχεία B2G: Λείπει η αναφορά έργου/προϋπολογισμού (BT-11).'. (4) Cron endpoint POST /api/cron/b2g-status: 401 without header (correct), 200 {ok:true,ranAt,orgs:[…]} with 'Authorization: Bearer dev-cron-secret-change-me'; two calls advanced TP-0006 pending→sent (run1 checked=1) → accepted (run2 accepted=1); invoice detail after cron shows 'Αποδεκτό από φορέα' + rawStatus simulation:accepted. (5) Invoices list: filter-b2g-pending and filter-b2g-rejected chips both render (org has b2gEnabled=true), URL becomes /invoices?b2g=pending; four b2g-badge-<invoiceId> testids present in the list (ced7b3c9…, cee26e8c…, 04b146f3…, bb64fa4d…). (6) Bell menu shows the B2G notification; /account notifications preferences page shows new type 'Απόρριψη/σφάλμα τιμολόγησης Δημοσίου' with description 'Ο φορέας ή ο πάροχος PEPPOL απέρριψε παραστατικό, ή λείπουν υποχρεωτικά στοιχεία B2G.' with in-app+email toggles. (7) Regression: /invoices /customers /account /dashboard /invoices/new /settings load fine, no Next.js overlay, no console pageerrors on any tested page.

critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/services/invoices.ts:376 autoSendB2G is wrapped in try/catch and notifies on any error — good: issuing never fails because of B2G side effects.
src/lib/services/invoices.ts:371 gate `docType.kind === 'invoice'` correctly excludes quotes and delivery notes from auto-send — good.

src/app/api/cron/b2g-status/route.ts:13 uses WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET ?? CRON_SECRET; if none is set it falls back to `return true` (open). In production this is defended by .env, but consider forcing 401 when secret is unset to fail-safe.

src/app/api/cron/b2g-status/route.ts also exposes GET → POST(req). This is convenient for browser pings but any GET that reaches this route re-runs the job; ok since it is idempotent and rate-limited by cron platform, but worth flagging.
Cron `.limit(50)` per org caps work per run — good for latency; if more than 50 pending exist they roll over to next hour. Acceptable but document.
listInvoices b2g filter uses status ∈ ('pending','sent') for pending and ('rejected','error') for rejected — matches chip labels. Good.
